styleDetail.cta: Apply this style to my room

minimalism.body: Minimalism is built on the idea that less can be better. The aim is a calm, useful room that keeps only what is needed or important. Every piece is chosen carefully so the interior stays simple and balanced.

scandinavian.body: Scandinavian style aims for a bright, warm, comfortable interior. Inspired by the Nordic countries, it favors simplicity, usefulness, and a welcoming mood, while letting in as much natural light as possible.

industrial.body: Industrial interior design draws on warehouses, factories, and converted utility spaces, celebrating raw materials and honest structure. These rooms balance vintage charm and contemporary comfort by mixing traditional elements with a minimal, modern design.

maximalism.body: Maximalism is controlled chaos. It celebrates individuality, creativity, and self-expression. It aims for rooms rich in personality and stories, mixing vintage and modern pieces with confidence.
traits: Plenty of art and personal souvenirs

japandi.body: Japandi mixes Japanese simplicity with Scandinavian comfort. It aims for calm, useful rooms where every object has a purpose. The result is warm, peaceful, and uncluttered.

contemporary.body: Current lines, mixed textures, and refined comfort for a room of today.

traditional.body: Symmetry, moldings, and classic furniture — elegance that lasts.

art_deco.body: Art Deco aims to create elegant, luxurious, sophisticated rooms, highlighting geometry, symmetry, and refined detail. It celebrates beauty, decoration, and craft, while giving a sense of order and prestige.

bauhaus.body: Bauhaus rests on the idea that form follows function: usefulness comes before ornament. Every design element should have a clear purpose, and every room should stay free of superfluous decoration. The style unites art and technology.
traits: Mix of industrial and natural materials

bohemian.body: Also called boho, this style expresses a desire for a free life. It builds a personal interior without strict rules, mixing influences, colors, textures, and objects from different cultures for a lively, authentic, holiday-like atmosphere.
traits: Controlled accumulation of objects and décor

cottagecore.body: Cottagecore is a new take on rustic aesthetics, centered on a peaceful rural way of life and countryside living. It looks for the nostalgic charm of a simpler time.
traits: No unused corners or overly precious finishes

exotic.body: Exotic style draws on cultures and regions around the world to create a warm, transporting interior with character. It mixes colors, materials, and objects inspired by travel and distant traditions.
traits: Patterns inspired by nature or other cultures

high_tech.body: High-Tech puts technology and innovation at the center of the room. It aims for a functional, sophisticated interior where technical equipment also becomes part of the décor.
traits: Equipment visible or built into furniture

modern.body: Form follows function: open volumes, little ornament, taut lines.

glamour.body: Glamour aims for an elegant, sophisticated, seductive atmosphere. It emphasizes refinement and visual pleasure, while the room still feels comfortable, confident, and prestigious.
traits: Mix of classic forms and modern touches

rustic.body: Drawing on country houses and traditional homes, rustic style favors simple elements and natural materials to create a room that feels authentic and warm.

about.title: roomia
about.lead: Interior design for Algerians who want a clear plan — not another endless catalog scroll.
about.p1: Roomia is an interior configurator for furnishing homes in Algeria. Scan a plan or photo, pick a style, arrange in 3D, and leave with a look you can buy.
about.p2: No designer fees. No overwhelming showrooms. Just your room — directed, visualized, quote-ready.
about.sarahDesc: Architect and interior designer. Every style, recommendation, and budget range in Roomia comes from her expertise.
about.aimenDesc: Full-stack developer. Built Roomia from the ground up — the configurator, the AI pipelines, the whole experience.
about.whyBody: Most people furnishing a home in Algeria have no structured tool. They scroll Instagram, visit stores with no plan, and overspend or under-decorate. Roomia gives them what used to require an expensive consultation — a real design direction, instantly.
about.contactBody: Questions, feedback, or partnership inquiries — we read everything.

partners.lead: When someone designs their home on Roomia, your catalog can be the recommendation. They click through. You pay commission — only on results.
partners.s1d: Your catalog gets matched to the right styles, rooms, and budgets inside the configurator.
partners.s2d: A living-room design in a traditional style with a comfortable budget surfaces your sofa.
partners.s3t: They click through to your store
partners.s3d: Every product links to your site. The buyer lands on you, ready to purchase.
partners.s4d: No upfront fees. No subscription. Commission only when Roomia drives a purchase.
partners.w1d: Every visitor already chose a style and a budget.
partners.w2d: You only pay when a Roomia user completes a purchase.
partners.w3d: No other platform like this exists in Algeria. Early partners get the best placement.
